newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Increased farmer sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Increased farmer sales.

text.p: Grain dealers in the northern U.S. Plains said Thursday that they noticed a slight increase in farmer selling of spring wheat.

"Most farmers look at grain in the bin as money in the bank, so whenever they need cash they just sell a little grain," a Minnesota dealer said. "I think some guys are having to pay off fertilizer bills, taxes, maybe some land payments, so that's generating a little movement."
A Montana dealer also reported seeing some movement, although he cautioned that it was not much.
"I didn't see the totals but I did talk to one of our elevator managers today and he bought around half a train -- 28 cars (of spring wheat)," the Montana dealer said.
Spring wheat bids were mostly lower in line with the board in Minneapolis. White wheat bids dropped 18 to 20 cents per bushel after Minneapolis Dec white wheat lost 19 cents to close at $4.04.
